summary: Nokia started as a Finnish wood pulp mill in 1865 and grew into the world's largest phone maker. The arrival of the iPhone in 2007 and then Android exposed its aging Symbian software. A 2011 bet on Microsoft's Windows Phone failed to turn things around, and Microsoft bought the phone business in 2013.
